outcome: success rate of initial respiratory support
cohort: 163 very low birth weight (VLBW) neonates receiving either invasive or non-invasive respiratory support in their first 72 hours of life.
finding: The success rates for NCPAP, NIPPV, and INSURE were 63.20%, 42.10%, and 61.90% respectively, with patent arterial duct significantly affecting initial respiratory support success, and gestational age and 5-min APGAR score significantly affecting the choice of initial respiratory support.
